content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for NAMO Hospital Daman Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required. Attend the Walk-in Interview on 15.10.2026 from 11:00 AM onwards at Conference Hall, NAMO Hospital, Daman. Submit one set of attested photocopies of educational qualifications, experience certificates, and other relevant documents. Prepare a five-minute PPT presentation (soft/hard copy) highlighting your professional achievements, professional experience, work experience, additional responsibilities, fellowship experience, certifications & professional course and other relevant contributions. Bring all original documents for verification. Submit your presentation to the office or email to [email protected] by 10.10.2026, before 5:30 PM.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NAMO Hospital Daman Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of applications for the NAMO Hospital Daman Recruitment 2026 is 10th October 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their presentations by this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the walk-in interview date for the NAMO Hospital Daman Medical Superintendent posts?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Medical Superintendent posts at NAMO Hospital Daman is scheduled for 15th October 2026. Candidates should report by 11:00 AM onwards.

faq.question: Q3. What are the eligibility criteria for the Medical Superintendent posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree with a PG Degree or Diploma in the respective subject (MS/MD/DNB) from a recognized institute. Registration with NMC or SMC is mandatory.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Medical Superintendent posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 8 vacancies for the Medical Superintendent posts at NAMO Hospital Daman, distributed across various specializations.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary structure for the Medical Superintendent posts?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 90,000/- pm for Diploma holders (fresh) to Rs. 1,75,000/- pm for Degree holders with over 5 years of experience, plus an incentive of Rs. 25,000/- pm.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What documents are required for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates need to bring original documents and one set of attested photocopies of educational qualifications, experience certificates, and other relevant documents.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Walk-in Interview and a PPT presentation highlighting professional achievements and experience.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the walk-in interview be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the Conference Hall, NAMO Hospital, Daman.

faq.question: Q10. Is prior online application required for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, this recruitment is through a Walk-in Interview, so no prior online application is required. Candidates can directly attend the interview.
